description: Find tools in the EasyCanDo catalog for one step of a build. Returns up to 10 previews, best first. Call get_tool before writing integration code.

free.description: Only tools that are free or have a free tier.

have.description: What the step starts with: words, photos, video, sound, documents, links, places, data, code, money, people, dates. A type id such as audio-speech also works.

live.description: Only tools with live or real-time data.

local.description: Only tools that run on the user’s own machine.

official.description: Only tools with an official API.

offset.description: Results to skip. Use the next_offset a search returns.

query.description: What the step does, in a few words, such as “transcribe audio”.

want.description: What the step should produce: words, photos, video, sound, documents, links, places, data, code, money, people, dates, done. done means the tool acts: it posts, sends, pays, books or changes something. A type id such as text also works.

name: search_tools

fallback.description: true when nothing matched the query. The note says what results hold instead.

looser.description: Looser matches left out: they match only part of the query, or only a side feature.

next_offset.description: The offset of the next page: send the same arguments with it. Left out on the last page.

offset.description: Results skipped before this page. Left out on the first page.

capability.description: The capability that matched. Left out when the tool lists none.

id.description: The capability’s stable id, unique within its tool, such as transcribe-recorded-audio. To pin a capability, store the tool’s slug and this id. https://easycando.com/mcp.md has the rules.

items.description: A type id, such as text, structured, code, query.
A type id, such as text, structured, code, query.

checked_on.description: The date the tool was last checked, YYYY-MM-DD.

live.description: true when it has live or real-time data; left out otherwise.

local.description: true when it runs on the user’s own machine; left out otherwise.

price_tier.description: free, freemium, low, mid, high or enterprise. https://easycando.com/mcp.md says what each means in dollars.

web_api.description: One of its ways in is a web protocol: REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, gRPC, SSE, SOAP, SPARQL, a stream or webhooks. False for a library, app, command line or local MCP server.

total.description: Results in all, across every page, looser matches left out. With fallback, the tools the filters leave.

widened.description: Results after the ones that pass have and want: matches for the query with other inputs or outputs. search_tools adds them only when fewer than 3 tools pass.

title: Search tools
